integrity: The result is an analytic specialization of published cross-MMD definitions. Numerical values are independently replayable from the bundled standard-library verifier. The theorem uses the classical pooled Student law; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional equal-variance Gaussian two-sample null, linear kernel, balanced halves. The exact law does not extend automatically to nonlinear characteristic kernels, heteroscedasticity, unequal splitting, or non-Gaussian samples.
title: Exact finite-sample \(t\)-law for Gaussian linear-kernel cross-MMD
